prose: Orchestrator, 2026-11-16: "A commit or land that changes a file inside a sealed proof's import closure reseals that proof, so a later ticket's close never reds on a seal that went stale on main; a seal with no recorded closure is resealed (or reds) rather than skipped." Each stale seal costs a walk, n=2 today: 40e4 q147 (test_sorted_probes) and 6095 q164 (test_sail_door). akienasus measured (a) only pre-commit reseals; a land's --no-ff merge never fires it, there is no pre-merge-commit hook; (b) test_sail_door.json at b7653ed35 has no fingerprint_closure key.
